Michael Carrick comments on referee apology after Manchester derby

Manchester United first-team coach Michael Carrick addressed an apology from Pro Referees regarding an error made during the Manchester derby. Carrick also provided an injury update on Benjamin Sesko, who missed the match against Fulham.
